lines.zh: 我抱着炸药跑，别撞我。
lines.en: I run carrying explosives, so do not bump me.

lines.zh: 恶地的红沙烫脚，我踮着走。
lines.en: The badlands sand burns my feet, so I tiptoe.

lines.zh: 我退两步，再退两步，一直退。
lines.en: I step back twice, then twice more, always back.

lines.zh: 洞穴里黑，我靠引线认路。
lines.en: Caves are dark; I find my way by the fuse.

lines.zh: 我腿短，可跑得比你想的快。
lines.en: My legs are short, but I run faster than you think.

lines.zh: 炸药在怀里晃，我抱得更紧。
lines.en: The charges swing in my arms and I hold tighter.

lines.zh: 我绕着圈子走，从不走直线。
lines.en: I walk in circles and never take a straight line.

lines.zh: 别追太近，我会掉头就跑。
lines.en: Do not get close; I will turn and bolt.

lines.zh: 红沙上留下一串小脚印。
lines.en: A line of small footprints trails across the red sand.

lines.zh: 我不是逃，我是在找角度。
lines.en: I am not fleeing; I am looking for an angle.

lines.zh: 引线拖在地上，像条尾巴。
lines.en: The fuse drags on the ground like a tail.

lines.zh: 走远点，这一路都危险。
lines.en: Keep your distance; this whole path is dangerous.

lines.zh: 我数了数，怀里还有六根。
lines.en: I counted: six sticks left in my arms.

lines.zh: 这仓库的门是我自己撬开的。
lines.en: I pried this depot door open myself.

lines.zh: 硝石的味道，比饭香。
lines.en: The smell of saltpeter beats any meal.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，炸药放在腿上。
lines.en: I sit down with the explosives on my knees.

lines.zh: 大人不让我进，我就自己进。
lines.en: Adults barred the door, so I let myself in.

lines.zh: 我在磨一根引线，磨得很短。
lines.en: I am trimming a fuse, cutting it very short.

lines.zh: 洞穴很静，只有我的呼吸。
lines.en: The cave is still, with only my breathing.

lines.zh: 我今年几岁？不重要。
lines.en: How old am I? That does not matter.

lines.zh: 我在想，先炸哪一块石头。
lines.en: I am deciding which rock to blow up first.

lines.zh: 别看我小，我懂的东西不少。
lines.en: Do not judge my size; I know plenty.

lines.zh: 站那么近，是想让我点火？
lines.en: Standing that close, do you want me to light it?

lines.zh: 你的靴子很新，可惜了。
lines.en: Your boots are new. What a shame.

lines.zh: 我在猜你能炸出几个坑。
lines.en: I am guessing how many craters you would leave.

lines.zh: 你比我高，正好当靶子。
lines.en: You are taller than me, which makes a fine target.

lines.zh: 别伸手，我怀里的东西怕碰。
lines.en: Do not reach out; what I carry dislikes being touched.

lines.zh: 你这眼神，像我爹抓到我偷东西。
lines.en: You look like my father catching me steal.

lines.zh: 我看你的手腕，不看你的眼睛。
lines.en: I watch your wrists, never your eyes.

lines.zh: 你在估距离，我心里也在估。
lines.en: You gauge the range; I am gauging it too.

lines.zh: 你一笑，我就想扔一根过去。
lines.en: When you smile, I want to toss one over.

lines.zh: 你这身甲，挡不住两声。
lines.en: That armor will not stop two blasts.

lines.zh: 疼！你打中我的胳膊了！
lines.en: Ow! You hit my arm!

lines.zh: 我流血了，火药沾了血。
lines.en: I am bleeding, and the powder is soaked.

lines.zh: 别打头，我还要算距离。
lines.en: Not the head; I still need to calculate distance.

lines.zh: 这一下，我退得更远。
lines.en: That hit pushed me further back.

lines.zh: 我怀里还抱着，没掉。
lines.en: I am still holding everything; nothing dropped.

lines.zh: 你打我，我就扔得更狠。
lines.en: Hit me and I throw harder.

lines.zh: 我在哭，但手没停。
lines.en: I am crying, but my hands have not stopped.

lines.zh: 血滴在引线上，滋滋响。
lines.en: Blood drips on the fuse and sizzles.

lines.zh: 你打断了我一根手指。
lines.en: You broke one of my fingers.

lines.zh: 我不怕疼，我怕炸不着你。
lines.en: Pain does not scare me; missing you does.

lines.zh: 面包？我宁可啃硝石。
lines.en: Bread? I would rather chew saltpeter.

lines.zh: 你拿糖哄我，我又不是三岁。
lines.en: You bribe me with candy; I am not three.

lines.zh: 别给我吃的，给我火药。
lines.en: Do not offer food; offer gunpowder.

lines.zh: 那味道让我分心，拿开。
lines.en: That smell distracts me, so take it away.

lines.zh: 我饿了，但手不能松。
lines.en: I am hungry, but I cannot loosen my grip.

lines.zh: 你把苹果举高，我就当你傻。
lines.en: Holding an apple up high just makes you look foolish.

lines.zh: 我兜里全是引线，塞不下饼。
lines.en: My pockets are full of fuse; no room for bread.

lines.zh: 喂我一口，我就少抱一根。
lines.en: Feed me a bite and I will drop one stick.

lines.zh: 食物会掉渣，渣会引火。
lines.en: Food leaves crumbs, and crumbs catch fire.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我还要留手点火。
lines.en: I will not eat; I need this hand for the flame.

lines.zh: 别撞！我怀里有东西！
lines.en: Do not bump me! There is something in my arms!

lines.zh: 你这一下，差点点着了。
lines.en: That shove nearly set it off.

lines.zh: 我被撞得后退，反而高兴。
lines.en: Being knocked back only pleases me.

lines.zh: 你贴太近了，我的规矩是三格。
lines.en: You are too close; my rule is three blocks.

lines.zh: 炸药磕在石头上，响了一声。
lines.en: The charge knocked stone and made a sound.

lines.zh: 让开，我转身的时候很宽。
lines.en: Move aside; I am wide when I turn.

lines.zh: 脚抬起来，你踩着引线。
lines.en: Lift your foot; you are on my fuse line.

lines.zh: 撞我可以，别撞我的货。
lines.en: Bump me if you must, not the goods.

lines.zh: 我摔倒了，怀里还抱着。
lines.en: I fell, and still clutched everything.

lines.zh: 这一碰，我记住了你的位置。
lines.en: That contact told me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我这种小孩，没人愿意搭档。
lines.en: A kid like me finds no partner.

lines.zh: 炸药是我的兄弟，够吵。
lines.en: The explosives are my brothers, loud enough.

lines.zh: 配对要两个人，我只带得动自己。
lines.en: Pairing takes two; I can barely carry myself.

lines.zh: 别问这个，我还没长大。
lines.en: Do not ask that; I have not grown up.

lines.zh: 仓库里只有我一个人的脚印。
lines.en: Only my footprints mark this depot.

lines.zh: 我抱的是引线，不是人。
lines.en: What I hold is a fuse, not a person.

lines.zh: 有个同伴，得分他一半火药。
lines.en: A partner would cost me half my powder.

lines.zh: 我不留后，我只留坑。
lines.en: I leave no heirs, only craters.

lines.zh: 两个人一起点，会炸得更快。
lines.en: Two lighting together would blow up faster.

lines.zh: 这事等我炸完再说。
lines.en: We can discuss that after the blast.

lines.zh: 捡起来塞进兜，留着有用。
lines.en: I pick it up, pocket it, and keep it for later.

lines.zh: 这块铁能做个壳子。
lines.en: This iron could become a casing.

lines.zh: 地上掉的，多半还能响。
lines.en: Most things dropped on the ground can still go off.

lines.zh: 我捡了根木棍，当引线杆。
lines.en: I picked up a stick to hold the fuse.

lines.zh: 别捡那个，那是我掉的。
lines.en: Do not pick that up; I dropped it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的时候，炸药会滑。
lines.en: When I bend over, the charges slide.

lines.zh: 这块石头，正好压引线。
lines.en: This rock is just right to weigh down a fuse.

lines.zh: 兜里满了，我咬在嘴里。
lines.en: My pockets are full, so I hold it in my teeth.

lines.zh: 捡东西要快，跑要更快。
lines.en: Picking things up takes speed; running takes more.

lines.zh: 我捡的不是宝贝，是材料。
lines.en: What I collect is not treasure but material.

lines.zh: 看见你了，在高处的石头上。
lines.en: I see you, up on that rock.

lines.zh: 二十三点生命，我经不起打。
lines.en: Twenty-three points of life will not last long.

lines.zh: 你走进我的射程，别怪我。
lines.en: You walked into my range; do not blame me.

lines.zh: 我先退，退到你够不着的地方。
lines.en: I back off first, out of your reach.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，引线已经点着。
lines.en: Target locked; the fuse is already lit.

lines.zh: 恶地上没有遮挡，你跑不掉。
lines.en: The badlands offer no cover; you cannot hide.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩碎石的声音了。
lines.en: I heard you crunch the gravel.

lines.zh: 别过来，我手里的东西不认人。
lines.en: Stay back; what I hold knows no friends.

lines.zh: 你比我高，所以我先动手。
lines.en: You are taller, so I strike first.

lines.zh: 两格距离，刚好够扔。
lines.en: Two blocks of distance is exactly enough to throw.

lines.zh: 我在洞口等你出来。
lines.en: I am waiting at the cave mouth for you.

lines.zh: 这地方我熟，你不熟。
lines.en: I know this place; you do not.

lines.zh: 你背对我，那就更简单了。
lines.en: You turned your back, which makes this easier.

lines.zh: 找到你了，仓库的规矩是先炸。
lines.en: Found you; depot rules say: blast first.

lines.zh: 我闻到火药，是我自己身上的。
lines.en: I smell gunpowder. It's my own.

lines.zh: 你比我壮，那我更该先扔。
lines.en: You're bigger than me, so I throw first.

lines.zh: 我举起来了，你还有一秒。
lines.en: I have raised it; you have one second.

lines.zh: 别冲，我退得比你快。
lines.en: Do not charge; I retreat faster than you advance.

lines.zh: 引线烧到一半了，听那声音。
lines.en: The fuse is half burned; hear it hiss.

lines.zh: 我在等你走进那个坑。
lines.en: I am waiting for you to step into that crater.

lines.zh: 你护着胸口，我就瞄脚。
lines.en: You guard your chest, so I aim at your feet.

lines.zh: 我不瞄准，我扔一片。
lines.en: I do not aim; I throw a spread.

lines.zh: 这一根，够把石头掀开。
lines.en: This one is enough to lift the rock.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡前面，后面是空的。
lines.en: Your shield faces front; your back is bare.

lines.zh: 手别抖，我抖得比你还厉害。
lines.en: Do not shake; my hands shake worse than yours.

lines.zh: 再迈一步，你就进坑了。
lines.en: One more stride and you are in the crater.

lines.zh: 我把引线咬短了，快得很。
lines.en: I bit the fuse short; it goes fast.

lines.zh: 你数三下，我数两下。
lines.en: You count to three; I count to two.

lines.zh: 洞穴顶很矮，炸起来更响。
lines.en: The cave roof is low, so the blast is louder.

lines.zh: 别回头，后面也有。
lines.en: Do not look back; there is one behind you too.

lines.zh: 我退到石堆后，从这里扔。
lines.en: I back behind the rocks and throw from here.

lines.zh: 引线短，所以你别眨眼。
lines.en: The fuse is short, so don't blink.

lines.zh: 我算的是你下一格的位置。
lines.en: I'm aiming where you'll stand next.

lines.zh: 你抱着头，那正好扔脚下。
lines.en: You cover your head. Perfect, I'll aim low.

lines.zh: 仓库里的货，我拿得比谁都快。
lines.en: I can grab the stock faster than anyone.

lines.zh: 这一根扔高些，落在你身后。
lines.en: This one goes high and lands behind you.

lines.zh: 接着，这是第一根。
lines.en: Catch; here is the first one.

lines.zh: 两格，抬手，扔出去。
lines.en: Two blocks, arm up, and release.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀起的沙子进了我眼。
lines.en: The blast threw sand into my eyes.

lines.zh: 你被震退了，我正好再退。
lines.en: The shock pushed you back, and I step back too.

lines.zh: 二点伤害不多，但会响。
lines.en: Two points of damage is small, but it makes noise.

lines.zh: 我扔完就跑，从不看结果。
lines.en: I throw and run, never checking the result.

lines.zh: 这一根是哑的，算你走运。
lines.en: That one was a dud; consider yourself lucky.

lines.zh: 你别躲，我算好了落点。
lines.en: Do not dodge; I already calculated the landing.

lines.zh: 火光一亮，你的影子就没了。
lines.en: The flash lights up and your shadow vanishes.

lines.zh: 我手小，扔不远，可够近。
lines.en: My hands are small, but close range is enough.

lines.zh: 你冲过来，那我就点近的。
lines.en: If you charge, I light a short one.

lines.zh: 这声响，整片恶地都听见了。
lines.en: That sound carried across the whole badlands.

lines.zh: 我扔的是石头包着火药。
lines.en: What I throw is rock wrapped around powder.

lines.zh: 退后点，炸完还有第二声。
lines.en: Stand back; a second blast follows the first.

lines.zh: 我扔完就抱住头蹲下。
lines.en: I throw, then curl up and cover my head.

lines.zh: 这一下掀起的土盖住了你。
lines.en: The dirt it kicks up buries you.

lines.zh: 火星溅到我脸上，有点烫。
lines.en: Sparks splash my face. A little hot.

lines.zh: 你被震得站不稳，我笑了。
lines.en: The blast staggers you, and I laugh.

lines.zh: 炸开之后，我换了个地方。
lines.en: After it blows, I'm already somewhere else.

lines.zh: 我扔得不准，可声音够大。
lines.en: My aim is poor, but the noise is plenty.

lines.zh: 我从洞穴的缝里爬出来了。
lines.en: I crawled out through a crack in the cave.

lines.zh: 恶地的风把我的引线吹歪了。
lines.en: The badlands wind bent my fuse sideways.

lines.zh: 仓库的门开着，我就进来了。
lines.en: The depot door stood open, so I walked in.

lines.zh: 生成权重十，这地方归我。
lines.en: Spawn weight ten; this patch belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我一出生，手里就有火药。
lines.en: I was born with gunpowder in my hands.

lines.zh: 红沙上多了个小影子。
lines.en: A small shadow appeared on the red sand.

lines.zh: 我数了数天，这里没有云。
lines.en: I counted the sky; there are no clouds here.

lines.zh: 我从石头后面站起来。
lines.en: I stood up from behind the stone.

lines.zh: 洞穴深处有回声，我顺着来。
lines.en: The deep cave echoed, and I followed it out.

lines.zh: 外面很亮，我眯起眼睛。
lines.en: Outside is bright, and I squint.

lines.zh: 我先找了块石头当掩体。
lines.en: First I found a rock to use as cover.

lines.zh: 有人在这埋过东西，我闻到了。
lines.en: Someone buried something here; I can smell it.

lines.zh: 别用火，我身上全是粉。
lines.en: Not fire; I am covered in powder.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下来，摔得闷响。
lines.en: I slid off the rock and landed with a thud.

lines.zh: 水一进来，火药就废了。
lines.en: Once water gets in, the powder is ruined.

lines.zh: 自己的货，炸了自己。
lines.en: My own goods went off on me.

lines.zh: 箭穿了我的袖子，钉在墙上。
lines.en: The arrow went through my sleeve and stuck in the wall.

lines.zh: 那药水让我手抖得点不着。
lines.en: That potion left my hands too shaky to light anything.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃，也忘了饿。
lines.en: I forgot to eat, and forgot hunger too.

lines.zh: 雷打在我旁边，耳朵嗡了半天。
lines.en: Lightning hit beside me and my ears rang for a while.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有声音，连爆炸也没有。
lines.en: The void has no sound, not even explosions.
